item.title: New Alzheimer's Treatment Clears Plaques from Brains of Mice Within Hours
item.description:
📝 New Alzheimer's Treatment Clears Plaques From Brains of Mice Within Hours Health15 October 2025By Carly Cassella Sticky protein clumps clog up brain cells in Alzheimer's disease. After treatment with nanoparticles (white), amyloid-beta deposits (red) were cleared from the brain side of the blood-brain barrier (green) and carried away in the blood. Their ultimate target is 'endothelial LRP1', which helps remove amyloid-beta plaques at the blood-brain barrier.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sciencealert.com/new-alzheimers-treatment-clears-plaques-from-brains-of-mice-within-hours
